# Health, travel and fraud review

Hospital stays, surgery and cashless claims declined or partly approved at network hospitals go to the Health team for review.

Treatment after a hospital stay, such as physiotherapy within 60 days of discharge, is reimbursed by the Health team.

A cancelled or delayed flight, a missed connection or lost baggage while travelling abroad is handled by the Travel team.

Send to Fraud review any claim where a purchase document is dated after the loss it supports.

Three or more claims of one kind on one policy within a year, or invoices from a shop that cannot be traced, go to Fraud review.

A question about what the policy covers, with no loss to claim, is not a claim: it goes to Other.
